justification: No board fixture can show this difference: it is in how a peer applies a realtime changepageattr frame, not in anything a stored board holds (the server stores the null; a reopen reads no margin on either engine). The frames below are what C++ SetPageMarginAction::raise (UserAction.cpp:1634-1651) and the TS SetPageMarginAction (src/edit/page-actions.ts) both send, byte for byte. Applied in order to a Letter page, C++ PageAttrChangeAction::apply (UpdateAction.cpp:457-470) ends with the margin shown at 90 x 90 after frame 3; lekhjs ends with no margin. Tests: test/sync/apply.test.ts and test/edit/round-trip.test.ts (DR-ENG-30).
